best_parts: node a_t0: names the wrong model (doubting the list because TOF is stored as shunt lesions), then refutes it with K3 and K13
node a_why: second probe on the same ASD/PDA trap, with ask_confidence, re-tests TR1 and TR3 in a different form
node a_ok: states the PYQ 'pentalogy' key and cites CDC (K76) in one step
flaws: a_t0 and a_t1 (and b_t0, b_t1 etc. in the step-doubt probes): the distractors are steps the sheet states correctly, so choosing them diagnoses doubt, not a wrong model; they are not the traps tagged (TR1, TR3) and do not map to one error each

probes b, c, d, e: the key is always 'Step 3' (third button), and the sheet form makes step 3 the inference; a student who has learned the form picks it without the content (DP1, key findable by form)
node a_why_t1 and a_t1: feedback opens by calling the sound step 'shaky' or 'tempting' before it is shown to be right; the reasoning is muddled for a tired student
node e_note and c_note (explain nodes in the main path) carry unverified-flagged claims; acceptable here because S7 is the exam-trap segment, but no deeper placement was used

best_parts: node not_t0: names the tempting reason (overriding aorta seems a stray) and refutes with K3 and the four-item list
node boot0 (drill 6): counter-case re-test of the boot-shape superlative in exam form, with warning-flagged claims placed in the exam segment
node share / num: numbers drilled in exam form with an anchor ('spells are the event this module keeps returning to') in the hint
flaws: node inc (drill 12): 'Both give about 1 in 300 live births' is dominated (about 30 times the figure); nobody with surface knowledge would pick it (DP2)
node arch (drill 13): '5 to 7 per 10,000' is a rate, not a share of TOF; a learner eliminates it on unit alone (DP2)
node share (drill 11): the key 'Up to 15%; 6% in one cohort' is the only hedged, two-figure option; key findable by form (DP1)
node boot_t0 (drill 2): feedback says only 'another cyanotic lesion with a named film is a fair guess', not the specific wrong model (TGA as the boot-shape lesion); R2 feedback is generic here
R7: 23 abstract 'Drill N' recall items with almost no clinical frame; the path reads as a quiz rather than decisions in a case

best_parts: node m3b / m3b_t1 / m3b_t2: pink-Tet classmate correction with three wrong models mapped to TR7, TR7 and TR8; feedback names each model and refutes with K23 and K22
node d4 (deeper, 22q11.2 versus Down syndrome): a deeper branch with 'Go deeper' agency that re-tests TR16 in the exam-trap form with warning flags
node m6 / m6_t1 / m6_t2: a classmate's swapped incidence and arch figures, corrected with the anchor 'share of TOF versus rate per 10,000 live births'
flaws: node m1_t1: 'ASD stays in the four; pentalogy adds a second VSD' carries two errors in one option (ASD in the four and a second VSD), against the one-error-per-option rule
node m4: the key 'A loud pulmonary component of S2' repeats the classmate's own wording ('P2 must be loud'), so a student can pick it by matching words rather than by content (DP1)
node d1_t1 and d1_t2: sure_note is null, so a confident error on the counter-case gets no hypercorrection note; this is inconsistent with the other trap nodes
node m2b_t1 (TR5): the feedback names plethora as the shunt picture but the 'extra pulmonary blood flow' option also borrows TR14 wording; minor overlap

merge_ideas: c's classmate-correction frame with b's single-stem PYQ forms (AIIMS-style recall, 'Which is NOT') for the R6 drill: the classmate sheet can carry a stem that is also asked cold
c's deeper branches (d1, d2, d3, d4) with b's warning-flagged exam-form items, so the flagged claims sit only in deeper nodes
a's sure_note wording on the confident-error path, applied to every trap node in c and b (c's d1 nodes currently have none)
b's dominated distractors replaced by c's classmate-style wrong corrections (for example 'Arch in about half of TOF'), so every option carries a live model
a's ask-confidence on each step of a multi-step sheet is a good way to surface overconfident wrong models; keep it, but move the key off 'Step 3'
